curriculum: TOQIX AI all-in-one domain curriculum v1

domains.camera_default: slow aerial reveal over the landscape
caption_templates: A {subject} in a vast natural landscape, {camera}, {lighting}, atmospheric depth and rich detail
A serene view of {setting} with {subject} moving through it, {camera}, natural light
domains.description: Mountains, forests, valleys, waterfalls, deserts, countryside.
example_prompts_en: A misty mountain valley at sunrise with a river winding through pine forests
A waterfall pouring into a green jungle pool after rain
example_prompts_ur: subah ke waqt pahadon ki wadi mein kohra aur behta darya
jangal mein barish ke baad girta hua aabshar
domains.extra_tokens: vast natural scenery, rich environmental detail, atmospheric depth
domains.label: Nature & Landscapes

domains.camera_default: slow cinematic pan across the water
caption_templates: A {subject} by the ocean under {weather} skies, {camera}, {lighting}
{weather} over {setting}, with {subject} in the foreground, {camera}
domains.description: Seas, beaches, rain, storms, snow, seasons and skies.
example_prompts_en: Ocean waves crashing on a rocky beach under a stormy sky
Gentle snowfall over a quiet frozen lake at dusk
example_prompts_ur: samandar ki lehren kinare se takra rahi hain toofani aasman ke neeche
shaam ko jheel par dheere dheere girti barf
domains.extra_tokens: dynamic sky and water, realistic weather atmosphere
domains.label: Ocean & Weather

domains.camera_default: slow crane shot rising over the street
caption_templates: A {subject} moving through a busy city street, {camera}, {lighting}, urban detail
Street life in {setting} with {subject}, {camera}, cinematic city atmosphere
domains.description: Urban life, streets, traffic, markets, skylines, old towns.
example_prompts_en: A busy city street at rush hour with buses, rickshaws and crowds crossing
An old town bazaar lane glowing with shop lights in the evening
example_prompts_ur: sheher ki mashhoor sarak par shaam ko traffic aur logon ka hujoom
purane bazaar ki gali mein roshan dukanein
domains.extra_tokens: busy urban atmosphere, architectural detail, street life
domains.label: Cities & Streets

caption_templates: A {subject} {action} in {setting}, {camera}, {lighting}, authentic daily-life feel
Candid moment of {subject} {action}, {camera}, natural expressions
domains.description: Families, work, school, cooking, friendships, everyday moments.
example_prompts_en: A grandmother teaching her grandchild to cook in a sunny kitchen
School children laughing and running out of school at the end of the day
example_prompts_ur: ek ladka apne doston ke saath ghar ke bahar khel raha hai
ek ladki subah nashta banate hue muskura rahi hai
domains.extra_tokens: authentic everyday emotion, natural human expressions and gestures
domains.label: People & Daily Life

domains.camera_default: telephoto tracking shot following the animal
caption_templates: A {subject} {action} in {setting}, {camera}, {lighting}, lifelike animal motion
Close view of a {subject} {action}, {camera}, detailed fur and natural behaviour
domains.description: Pets, wildlife, birds, farm and sea animals in motion.
example_prompts_en: A cheetah sprinting across golden grassland chasing the wind
A kitten playing with a ball of yarn on a wooden floor
example_prompts_ur: ek billi barish mein bhaag rahi hai
ghora kheet mein tez daud raha hai
domains.extra_tokens: true-to-life animal behaviour and anatomy, detailed fur and feathers
domains.label: Animals

caption_templates: A close-up of {subject} being prepared, {camera}, {lighting}, appetizing detail and steam
{subject} served fresh in {setting}, {camera}, rich food textures
domains.description: Dishes, street food, cooking processes, steam and sizzle.
example_prompts_en: Steam rising from a fresh plate of biryani as a spoon lifts the first bite
A chef tossing vegetables in a flaming wok at a street food stall
example_prompts_ur: garam garam chai ki piyali se uthta dhuwan
tawe par banti hui garma garam roti
domains.extra_tokens: appetizing detail, steam and texture, shallow depth of field
domains.label: Food & Cooking

domains.camera_default: dynamic tracking shot following the action
caption_templates: A {subject} {action} during a match, {camera}, {lighting}, high-energy sports motion
Slow-motion view of {subject} {action}, {camera}, athletic detail
domains.description: Cricket, football, racing, martial arts, athletics, extreme sports.
example_prompts_en: A batsman hitting a powerful six as the stadium crowd erupts
A swimmer diving into a blue pool in slow motion
example_prompts_ur: ladka cricket khelte hue zabardast shot marta hai
ek tairne wala neele pool mein chhalang lagata hai
domains.extra_tokens: high-energy athletic motion, realistic physics and effort
domains.label: Sports & Action

domains.camera_default: low tracking shot moving with the vehicle
caption_templates: A {subject} travelling through {setting}, {camera}, {lighting}, realistic motion and reflections
{subject} in motion on {setting}, {camera}, sense of speed
domains.description: Cars, bikes, trains, planes, boats and journeys.
example_prompts_en: A red sports car speeding along a coastal highway at sunset
A passenger train crossing a high bridge over a green valley
example_prompts_ur: ek gaari pahadi sarak par tez ja rahi hai
kashti samandar mein safar kar rahi hai
domains.extra_tokens: realistic vehicle motion and reflections, sense of speed
domains.label: Vehicles & Transport

domains.camera_default: slow majestic dolly shot through the scene
caption_templates: A {subject} in space near {setting}, {camera}, {lighting}, epic sci-fi scale
{subject} exploring {setting}, {camera}, detailed futuristic technology
domains.description: Astronauts, rockets, planets, robots, futuristic technology.
example_prompts_en: An astronaut planting a glowing flag on the moon with Earth in the sky
A rocket launching at dawn leaving a trail of fire and smoke
example_prompts_ur: chand par khada khala baz zameen ki taraf dekh raha hai
rocket aasman ki taraf udta hua aag ka nishan chor raha hai
domains.extra_tokens: epic scale, detailed spacecraft and suits, volumetric light
domains.label: Space & Sci-Fi
domains.lighting_default: dramatic space lighting with strong contrast

domains.camera_default: sweeping crane shot revealing the magical scene
caption_templates: A {subject} in a magical {setting}, {camera}, {lighting}, mythical wonder
{subject} casting magic in {setting}, {camera}, enchanted atmosphere
domains.description: Dragons, castles, magic, mythical worlds and creatures.
example_prompts_en: A dragon soaring over a medieval castle at twilight
A young wizard opening a glowing spell book in a dark forest
example_prompts_ur: ek bara dragon purane qile ke upar ud raha hai
jangal mein jadoo ki roshni phailti hui
domains.extra_tokens: magical atmosphere, mythical detail, wonder and scale
domains.label: Fantasy & Magic

caption_templates: An anime-style {subject} {action} in {setting}, {camera}, {lighting}, cel shaded
A cartoon {subject} {action}, {camera}, expressive stylized animation
domains.description: Anime scenes, cartoon characters, stylized 2D/3D animation.
example_prompts_en: An anime girl with a red scarf standing on a hill as wind moves the grass
A cartoon panda and a tiny robot building a toy rocket together
example_prompts_ur: anime ladki pahadi par khadi hawa mein udta dupatta
cartoon billi aur chota robot dost khel rahe hain
domains.extra_tokens: cel shading, expressive characters, fluid sakuga animation
domains.label: Anime & Cartoon Style

domains.camera_default: slow crane shot rising along the structure
caption_templates: A {subject} in {setting} shown in full grandeur, {camera}, {lighting}, architectural detail
Slow reveal of {subject}, {camera}, precise geometry and scale
domains.description: Buildings, monuments, interiors, historical and modern design.
example_prompts_en: A white marble mosque glowing in morning light with birds circling the dome
A modern glass skyscraper reflecting a dramatic sunset sky
example_prompts_ur: ek khubsurat masjid subah ki roshni mein chamak rahi hai
bara pul darya ke upar shaam ko roshan hai
domains.extra_tokens: precise architectural detail, grand scale, clean geometry
domains.label: Architecture & Places

domains.camera_default: orbiting camera shot circling the celebration
caption_templates: A {subject} celebrating {event} in {setting}, {camera}, {lighting}, festive cultural detail
Joyful scenes of {event} with {subject}, {camera}, colorful celebration
domains.description: Eid, weddings, Diwali, parades, traditions, celebrations.
example_prompts_en: Families celebrating Eid in a courtyard decorated with lights and sweets
A colorful wedding procession with dancers and drummers in the street
example_prompts_ur: eid ke din ghar mein sajawat aur bachon ki khushi
shaadi mein naach gaane ke saath baraat aati hui
domains.extra_tokens: joyful celebration, colorful cultural detail, crowd energy
domains.label: Festivals & Culture
domains.lighting_default: festive warm light with colorful accents

domains.camera_default: smooth dolly shot through the workspace
caption_templates: A {subject} working in {setting}, {camera}, {lighting}, modern professional detail
{subject} using advanced technology in {setting}, {camera}, clean tech aesthetic
domains.description: Offices, startups, gadgets, labs, factories, future work.
example_prompts_en: A young engineer testing a robot arm in a bright modern laboratory
A startup team presenting around a glass table in a sunlit office
example_prompts_ur: daftar mein ek ladka computer par kaam kar raha hai
factory mein machine chalti hui aur mazdoor kaam karte hue
domains.label: Business & Technology

domains.camera_default: slow hypnotic push through the abstract scene
caption_templates: Abstract {subject} flowing in {setting}, {camera}, {lighting}, fluid artistic motion
Surreal {subject} with {colors}, {camera}, dreamlike composition
domains.description: Colors, shapes, particles, ink, surreal and experimental visuals.
example_prompts_en: Colorful ink swirling and blooming in clear water in slow motion
Golden particles forming a glowing geometric mandala in darkness
example_prompts_ur: paani mein rangeen siyahi phailti hui khoobsurat shaklein banati hai
andhere mein chamakte sunehray zaray gol ghumte hue
domains.extra_tokens: fluid abstract motion, rich color gradients, artistic composition
domains.label: Abstract & Art

note: The owner's 'train it on everything' instruction, implemented as data: every major video domain with bilingual example prompts and caption templates. The base model's broad knowledge comes from its open weights; this curriculum steers prompting, balanced batch generation and dataset curation; user data then specializes the model via the flywheel LoRA rounds.
